description: Every multi-valued region alias that survives Java's Locale boundary, requested against English. English's likely region (US) appears in none of the twenty-three alias value lists, verified against vendor cldr-locale-data.json, so each request must land on the FIRST value of its list. One en-<first value> catalog per distinct target, plus en-US for the single-valued 840 control. Tiebreakers are MANDATORY here and are an exact permutation of all eleven loaded en locales.
